entries.title: Visage

emulation.notes: Capture the native PS5 Enhanced Edition. Use PC only if workflow convenience outweighs the sourced enhanced-console features.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS5 Enhanced Edition at documented 4K/60 with improved loading and haptic support.

primary.why: The PS5 Enhanced Edition is the best fidelity route because the current-generation Enhanced Edition runs at 4K/60 with improved loading, and PS5 adds DualSense haptic support. The PC version remains a strong capture route, but the Enhanced Edition improvements are specific to PS5/Xbox Series.
primary.how_to_play: Play Visage: Enhanced Edition on PlayStation 5. Use Windows PC only if capture/settings flexibility matters more than the sourced enhanced-console feature set.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release with PC settings/capture flexibility.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong capture route, but the sourced 4K/60 Enhanced Edition features are documented for PS5/Xbox Series.
skip: superseded for fidelity by the current-generation Enhanced Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced Edition documented with 4K/60 and improved loading.
all_releases.reason: skip: same enhanced route as PS5, but PS5 is selected for the extra sourced DualSense haptic support.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced Edition documented with 4K/60, improved loading, and DualSense haptic support.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the easiest capture/settings route, but the Enhanced Edition brings 4K/60 improvements specifically to PS5/Xbox Series; PS5 is chosen for its enhanced feature set.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition is a current-generation console upgrade of the 2020 game, not a separate sequel.
